Distribution and Biology. Prophylactis gracilipax sp. nov. was found on Boronia gracilipes F. Muell. across much of its range from Manjimup south to Windy Harbour and east to Denmark (Fig. S 3 A). The hostplant grows in moist Karri forests from Margaret River on the west coast to Mt Manypeaks near Albany in Western Australia (Duretto et al. 2013). Prophylactis gracilipax sp. nov. was observed across the flowering period of B. gracilipes from mid-October to early December. Compared with the single non-pollinator group species of Prophylactis associated with B. gracilipes, P. gracilipax sp. nov. was never abundant, and more study is required to determine the extent of its role in pollination.
